sign_in_demo_notice: Demo version: all data is fictional.
sign_in_demo_accounts: Sign in as {emails} with the password
sign_in_no_methods: No sign-in method is configured yet.
sign_in_error_domain: This email domain can’t sign in here. Use your company Google account.
no_access_body: Your account isn’t a member of any organization. Ask an organization admin for an invitation, then sign in again.
error_not_organization_member: You are not a member of this organization.
error_profile_left: This person has left the organization.
error_update_request_forbidden: Only admins can request profile updates.
error_update_request_open: This profile already has an open update request.
period_parts_hint: The day is optional. Leave the month empty if you only know the year.
period_year_only: A year alone is vague in a CV. Add the month if you know it.
period_end_before_start: The end can’t be before the start.
period_ongoing_after_project_end: The project has ended, so enter when you finished.
period_after_project_end: Can’t be after the project’s end.
period_before_project_start: Can’t be before the project’s start.
period_day_without_month: A day needs a month too.
period_year_required: Enter the year as four digits.
error_technology_forbidden: Only admins can change catalogue entries.
error_technology_name_invalid: The name needs at least one letter or digit.
error_technology_exists: That technology is already in the catalogue.
error_technology_merge_self: Choose another technology to merge into.
error_criterion_forbidden: Only admins can manage the technical characteristics.
error_role_name_invalid: The Estonian name needs at least one letter or digit.
error_role_exists: That role is already in the list.
error_role_merge_self: Choose another role to merge into.
technologies_employee_hint: Add a technology that’s missing. Admins tidy names and categories.
technology_name_hint: The same name in both languages, for example PostgreSQL.
technology_picker_search: Add a technology from the catalogue

match.projectsPlural=one, peoplePlural=one: Its uses on {projects} project and by {people} person move to the chosen technology, and “{name}” leaves the catalogue.
match.projectsPlural=one, peoplePlural=*: Its uses on {projects} project and by {people} people move to the chosen technology, and “{name}” leaves the catalogue.
match.projectsPlural=*, peoplePlural=one: Its uses on {projects} projects and by {people} person move to the chosen technology, and “{name}” leaves the catalogue.
match.projectsPlural=*, peoplePlural=*: Its uses on {projects} projects and by {people} people move to the chosen technology, and “{name}” leaves the catalogue.

bilingual_one_required: Fill in at least one language.
criteria_description: Yes or no questions that tenders ask about a project’s solution. Every project answers each one.
criteria_bilingual_hint: The list flags a missing translation.
criteria_remove_unanswered: The characteristic leaves the checklist. No project has answered it.
criteria_empty: No characteristics yet. Add the first one, for example “Automated tests”.

match.countPlural=one: The characteristic leaves the checklist and the projects. The answers of {count} project are kept but no longer shown.
match.countPlural=*: The characteristic leaves the checklist and the projects. The answers of {count} projects are kept but no longer shown.

roles_description: Project roles that employees pick for their participations. A CV uses the name in its language.
role_add_description: The role joins the organization’s list of roles. A CV needs both languages.

match.countPlural=one: Its {count} use moves to the chosen role, and “{name}” leaves the list.
match.countPlural=*: All {count} uses move to the chosen role, and “{name}” leaves the list.

project_details_hidden: Admins and the project’s participants see the tender details and contact persons.
error_project_name_invalid: The name needs at least one letter or digit.
project_name_hint: The same name in both languages.
project_similar: A project with a similar name exists: {name} ({customer}). Is it the same one?
project_section_description_hint: A CV uses the chosen language. A missing translation is flagged before the CV is generated.
project_section_tender_hint: Admins and the project’s participants see these.
project_delete_body: The project leaves the project list, search, and CVs, and its participations stop showing on profiles.
error_contact_forbidden: Only admins can change contact persons.
error_contact_other_customer: A project’s contact persons must be its customer’s.
project_section_contacts_hint: People at the customer who can be named as tender references. Tick the ones who are references for this project.
contact_invalid_label: Can no longer act as a reference
contact_delete_confirm: Delete {name} from the customer’s contact persons? Every project of the customer loses them as a reference.
contacts_no_customer: Choose the customer first: contact persons are the customer’s.
contacts_new_customer: Save the project first to add contact persons for the new customer.
contacts_none: The customer has no contact persons yet.

match.countPlural=one: The project’s {count} contact person belongs to the current customer and will be removed from the project.
match.countPlural=*: The project’s {count} contact persons belong to the current customer and will be removed from the project.

project_participant_technologies_hint: Add the ones the project used. Participants’ CVs don’t change either way.
project_section_criteria_hint: Answer yes or no for each one. A note is internal and stays out of CVs.
error_profile_join_after_left: The join date can’t be after the date the person left.
profile_birth_date_hint: Optional. Only you and admins see it; it goes into a CV only when chosen.
education_dates_hint: Dates are optional: older entries often lack them.
error_participation_outside_project: The period must be within the project’s period.
profile_section_participations_hint: Your role and work on the organization’s projects.
participation_empty: No participations yet. Add a project you’ve worked on.
participation_delete_confirm: Delete your participation in {name}? The project stays, with the other participants.
participation_technologies_hint: Remove the ones you didn’t use, and add the ones only you used. Changes to the project don’t change your list.
profile_section_own_hint: Only on your CV: projects from an earlier employer, or several engagements merged into one. They stay out of the organization’s project list and search.
own_employer_hint: When the work was done for another company.
own_project_details_hint: Optional: the whole project’s size and tender details.
own_delete_confirm: Delete the own project {name}? It leaves your profile and your CVs.
error_member_forbidden: Only admins can manage the members.
error_member_last_admin: The organization needs at least one admin.
members_last_admin: The organization needs at least one admin, so you can’t change your own role.
error_invitation_member: This person is already a member.
error_invitation_pending: This address already has a pending invitation.
error_invitation_other_email: This invitation is for another email address. Sign in with the address it was sent to.
error_invitation_canceled: This invitation was canceled. Ask an admin for a new one.
error_invitation_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask an admin for a new one.
invite_description: You get a link to send yourself. Whoever signs in with a Google account at this email address accepts it.
invite_copy_failed: Couldn’t copy. Select the link and copy it instead.
error_invitation_used: This invitation has already been used. Ask an admin for a new one.
error_profile_forbidden: Only admins can see everyone’s profiles.
error_profile_left_before_join: The leaving date can’t be before the join date.
error_update_request_not_found: This person has no open update request.
request_description: {name} sees the request at their next sign-in.

match.countPlural=one: The request goes to {count} person who doesn’t have an open request yet. They see it at their next sign-in.
match.countPlural=*: The request goes to {count} people who don’t have an open request yet. They see it at their next sign-in.

request_nobody: Everyone already has an open request.
leave_body: The profile is kept, but search and new CVs leave it out by default. The participations stay on the projects. Their access ends now.
update_request_banner: An admin asked you to review your profile.
profile_confirmed_body: Admins can see that your details are current.
search_description: Find people by technology and by the solution characteristics of their projects, and by period if you like.
search_characteristics_hint: The project must have every one you choose. Own projects have none, so they are left out.
period_filter_hint: Year, month and year (03-2024), or a full date.
period_filter_invalid: Enter a year, a month and year, or a date.
search_prompt: Choose at least one technology or characteristic.
search_no_match: Nobody matches. Try a wider period, fewer technologies, or fewer characteristics.
cv_description: Choose the people, the language, and the projects.
cv_include_birth_date_hint: Only when the tender asks for it.
cv_no_projects: No projects match. Try a wider period or other technologies.
cv_missing_body: These texts aren’t in the CV’s language yet. The CV shows them in the other language, highlighted, until they are translated.
cv_copied: Copied. Paste it into Word, Google Docs, or a spreadsheet.
cv_copy_failed: Couldn’t copy. Select the table and copy it instead.
cv_columns_provisional: The columns are provisional: which ones tenders need is still open.
